scenes.headline: How a video model learns to move a robot arm
scenes.sub: FLUX 3 Action denoises future frames and actions in one sequence
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sumac! FLUX 3 Action is Black Forest Labs' open robot policy. Here's how a video model learns to move an arm.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Robot actions are denoised in the same sequence as the future video they would cause, so video pretraining becomes motor knowledge.
scenes.mark: in the same sequence as the future video
scenes.say: Its trick: denoise the next actions in the same sequence as the video they would cause.

steps.say: Three clean inputs: the instruction, three cameras in three hundred and forty tokens, and one token of joint angles.
Beside them, pure noise: future video and thirty-two actions. Each stream first gets five private blocks.

steps.note: an action token can read the frame it will cause
steps.say: Then everything meets in twenty-eight shared blocks, where actions read the frames they will cause.
Four denoising steps later, the actions come out as joint targets. The imagined video is thrown away.
BFL's own drawing shows the same shape: every layer carries task, history, state, future and action features.
In the released code, only the action tokens get decoded. The future tokens never become frames.

items.text: Pretrain on image, video and audio
items.say: It starts from the FLUX 3 backbone, pretrained on images, video and audio, mostly video.
Next it trains on video paired with actions: games, human hands, grippers and teleoperation.

items.text: Fine-tune a full copy per robot
items.say: Each robot then gets a full fine-tune of the whole trunk.
Distillation bakes in the guidance, then cuts four steps to one.

scenes.title: RoboLab-120 task success
scenes.note: best of six seeds; the six-seed mean is 41.60%
scenes.say: On a hundred and twenty simulated tasks it ranks first, at forty-two point nine percent: the best of six seeds, whose mean is forty-one point six.

scenes.label: parameters in the base DiT, counted from the file headers
scenes.note: 12.64B once the text encoder and video VAE load
scenes.say: And the seven billion is honest: six point nine nine billion in the backbone, twelve point six with the text encoder and video autoencoder.

scenes.text: Most of every forward pass is imagined future video that is never shown; the actions are read off that imagination.
scenes.say: Most of every forward pass is imagined video nobody sees. The actions are read off that imagination.

recap: Five streams, private blocks, then 28 shared
First on RoboLab, best of six seeds
scenes.say: Five streams, shared blocks, and actions denoised beside imagined video.
